en.answer:
When resolving the effect of <<15243>> in question, if you have 1 or less card(s) in your Extra Deck, you will not send any cards to the Graveyard, but your opponent still sends 2 monsters from their Extra Deck to the Graveyard.

Also, when your opponent has 1 or less card(s) in their Extra Deck, your opponent will not send any cards to the Graveyard, but you will still send 2 monsters with different names from your Extra Deck to the Graveyard.
en.question: When resolving the effect of <<15243>> that sends cards from both player's Extra Deck to the Graveyard that I activated, what happens if either player has 1 or less card(s) in their Extra Deck?
en.title: What happens if either player has 1 or less card(s) in their Extra Deck when resolving the effect of <<15243>> that sends cards from both player's Extra Deck to the Graveyard?

ja.answer:
自分の「<<15243>>」の『②』のモンスター効果の処理時に、自分のエクストラデッキが１枚以下になっている場合、『自分のEXデッキからカード名が異なるモンスター２体を墓地へ送る』処理を行う事はできませんが、相手プレイヤーは『相手は自身のEXデッキからモンスター２体を墓地へ送る』処理を行います。

また、自分の「<<15243>>」の『②』のモンスター効果の処理時に、相手のエクストラデッキが１枚以下になっている場合、相手プレイヤーは『相手は自身のEXデッキからモンスター２体を墓地へ送る』処理を行う事はできませんが、自分は『自分のEXデッキからカード名が異なるモンスター２体を墓地へ送る』処理を行います。
